title: The Toxic Logic of “Serve Him Because He Saved You”

top_liked.author: @adjoahossou454
top_liked.text: like a parent saying i sacrificed my dreams to raise you so you have to live my dreams.

top_liked.author: @grocerygoat06
top_liked.text: I never asked to be born. I didn't have a choice to be here. I was forced here against my will, yet I'll burn in hell if I don't believe in a Bronze Age story?

top_liked.author: @insanetubegain
top_liked.text:
Jesus: Let me save you.
Me: From what?
Jesus: From what the God of Abraham will do to you if you don't.

Yeah, it sound like a gangster insurance scheme.

top_liked.author: @JJ-qo7th
top_liked.text:
"He died for your sins.  You should be grateful"  
"That's emotional blackmail.  I didn't ask to be saved, and he doomed me in the first place."  
"Also, he didn't stay dead."
"Okay, so we can add gaslighting to the list, too."

top_liked.author: @brenatevi
top_liked.text: As an ex-Christian, I've called Christianity a 2000 year-old case of Stockholm Syndrome.

top_liked.author: @johncordell1742
top_liked.text: I was indoctrinated as a kid to the Catholic church. I feel fortunate that my critical thought never left me and I became an atheist at 15. I'm now 58 and know I made the right choice.

top_liked.author: @brettstarks1846
top_liked.text: The supposed “sacrifice” of Jesus always cracks me up. Having one rough weekend in exchange for being the Lord and Savior for all eternity seems like a pretty sweet gig.

top_liked.author: @christopheryannatone4406
top_liked.text: “Belief under threat is not faith but it is psychological hostage taking” WELL said my man!

top_liked.author: @thecoffeecove81
top_liked.text: I am still new to "deconstructing" and I feel like I am "ping ponging" in between as I navigate this new journey. I just got to the point where I couldn't keep pretending. I have had a LOT of questions the last few years and have noticed a lot of contradictions that I just…

top_liked.author: @hummingbirdcity
top_liked.text: Right. A "free gift" doesn't come with a life-long stipulation that you always do what the gift-giver wants.
